spec.goal: The AI panel notices a selected card and can be collapsed and expanded
steps: Press 新建画布 to create a canvas
Press 提示词 in the 添加卡片 toolbar
Click the 提示词 card's title to select it
Press 收起 AI 助手
Press the AI 助手 button in the header
